prayers.text:
He is God.

O, merciful, beloved Lord in heaven! These companions are those who are intoxicated with the Wine of the Covenant, and who wander through the deserts of Thy love. Their hearts are burning with the fire of separation from Thee, and they earnestly long for the revelation of Thy glory. Reveal unto them from Thy hidden, secret abode, Thy unseen Kingdom, the radiant glory of Thy bounty and grace, and bestow upon them the light of Thy favour and blessings. Send down unto them, moment by moment, new signs of Thy tokens, and manifest unto them the renewed bestowals of Thy grace and favour.

O, Thou Divine Oracle! We are weak, but Thou art All-Powerful. We are like unto ants, but Thou art the King of the Lord of the Glorious Universe. Bestow upon us of Thy favour, and grant us of Thy blessings, that we may set ablaze the flame of Thy love, and its radiant light may shine upon all lands, manifesting Thy might and power. Strengthen our endeavors to bring light into this dark world, and spirituality into this mortal realm. Aid us to be ever active, and not to defile ourselves with the transient things of this life. Help us to set the banquet of Thy divine guidance, to engrave the verses of Thy love with our life-blood, to leave behind fear and peril, to become like trees bearing fruit, and to manifest the perfection of humanity in this fleeting world. Verily, Thou art the Bountiful, the Most Merciful, the Ever-Forgiving, the Pardoner.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

th:bpnet.cat: บทอธิษฐานในที่ประชุมหรือที่ชุมนุม

prayers.text: O Merciful Lord! Thou art the Bountiful and the Merciful! We are servants in Thy field and subject to Thy watch and kindness. The sun of Thy help shines on all and the clouds of Thy mercy rain on all. Thy gifts encompass all, Thy help revives all, Thy protection shelters all, and the rays of Thy favour illuminate all. O Lord! Grant us of Thy boundless bestowal and light the lamp of Thy guidance. Enlighten the eyes, gladden the souls, and infuse new spirit into the hearts. Grant them everlasting life. Open the doors of Thy knowledge, let the lamp of faith be kindled. Unite and lead the people to one refuge under the banner of Thy protection, that they may be like the waves of one sea, the leaves and branches of one tree, and may gather under the shade of the same tent. May they drink from the same fountain. May they be revived by the same breeze. May they be enlightened by the same source of light and life. Thou art the Bestower, the Merciful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

lo:bpnet.cat: ບົດອະທິຖານເພື່ອມະນຸດຊາດ

prayers.text: O ye two faithful and assured souls! The letter was received. Praise be to God, it imparted good tidings. California is ready for the promulgation of the Teachings of God. My hope is that ye may strive with heart and soul that the sweet scent may perfume the nostrils.… Convey on my behalf to Mrs. Chase respectful greetings and say: “Mr. Chase is a twinkling star above the horizon of Truth, but at present it is still behind the clouds; soon these shall be dispersed and the radiance of that star shall illumine the state of California. Appreciate thou this bounty that thou hast been his wife and companion in life.” Every year on the anniversary of the ascension 1 of that blessed soul the friends must visit his tomb on behalf of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá and in the utmost lowliness and humility should with all respect lay on his grave wreaths of flowers and spend all the day in quiet prayer, while turning their faces toward the Kingdom of Signs and mentioning and praising the attributes of that illustrious person.
prayers.name: SWAB 164

prayers.text: He is the All-Glorious. O thou spiritual physician! The body of humankind was afflicted with severe ills and chronic diseases, contagious maladies and prolonged fevers. Whereupon the ocean of divine favour surged, and the clouds of truth and bounty rained down upon the world of creation. The Sun of the firmament of Oneness shone forth, and vivifying breezes wafted from the meads of Singleness. The breath of the divine Messiah was diffused, the All-Knowing Physician appeared from behind the veil, and the skilled and true Healer emerged unconcealed. He prepared wholesome medicines from hidden substances, and created healing balms from concealed and treasured elements. He bestowed the panacea of unfailing efficacy, and conferred the sovereign remedy for every ill. He blended together spiritual elixirs, and created refreshing draughts made with heavenly pearls and rubies. And from the essence of Divine Unity and the quintessence of singleness, He taught and made known to us remedies that purify and tranquillize and soothe. And all this, so that the feeble frame of the world might be freed from the burning thirst of error and ignorance, and this afflicted body might be delivered from the sore distress of heedlessness and impotence and attain unto a state of divine health and a well-being spiritual, complete, and absolute. Yet ignorant and neglectful physicians devoid of learning have intervened and are preventing the divine and timely remedy from being administered. They prescribe instead that which causeth the aggravation of the disease and the worsening of the condition. Thou who hast discovered the storehouse of celestial remedies and the infallible divine medicines must strive, then, that haply the light of perfect health and unfailing tranquillity may shine forth even as the light of guidance from the Dayspring of healing, and that the obscuring gloom of ills may be dispelled and the deadly affliction of maladies eliminated.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: He is the All-Glorious. O thou dove of the rose-garden of faithfulness! O nightingale of the groves of praise to the Abhá Beauty! May the glory of God, His mercy, His bounty, and His praise rest upon thee. That which thou hadst written with the pen of grief upon the page of woes was read and perused with the utmost attention. From its contents, brimming with bitter lamentation, the savour of profound sorrow and anguish was perceived. On the one hand, I was saddened; on the other, surprised and amazed. My sorrow was due to the intensity of thy sighs, whilst my surprise stemmed from the fact that this servant hath already written a number of letters to thee, dear friend, in all of which I expressed the utmost measure of love and affection. They were written in such wise that I imagined that such bliss and ecstasy would fill thy soul upon their perusal as to cause thee to rend asunder the raiment of the material world. How is it that through a single word thou hast become so dispirited and dejected, so heartbroken and despondent? And yet, in this day, neither is praise the measure of honour, nor censure the sign of abasement and disgrace. Acceptance or denial, approval or rejection, all depend upon him whom God hath raised to serve His Cause and to exalt His Word amidst humankind. Know thou that all matters pertaining to the Cause revert to this servant. To none is given the right to reject or accept before hearing what this humble servant hath pronounced. Forget then all these matters and, with the utmost resolve, firmness, and steadfastness in the Covenant of God, and with faithful adherence unto His Testament, strive to exalt His Word. Neither give ear to commendation and praise, nor be saddened or heartbroken by censure and humiliation. Arise amidst the peoples of the world and, wholly detached and sanctified from all save God and stirred by His Covenant and Testament, strive to awaken the heedless; for, in this day, most people are unaware and oblivious of the power of God’s Covenant and Testament. Although no explicit Covenant was established in any previous age or Dispensation, yet the followers of the Qur’án say that the Apostle of God—may the life of the worlds be offered up for His sake—stated at Gh adír-i- Kh umm: “Whoever hath Me as his Master, hath ‘Alí as his Master.” 111 Likewise, the Christians say that the One Who is the Spirit—may the soul of all existence be sacrificed for Him—addressed Simon, known as Peter, with these words: “Thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church.” 112 Now, in this Most Great Dispensation, the Covenant hath been conclusively established in clear terms and unmistakable language, leaving room for no interpretation whatever, in the Most Holy Book—a Book that abrogateth all the Sacred Scriptures of the past, and whose laws have annulled whatever laws in other Tablets that are not in conformity with it. Furthermore, in the book of the divine Covenant and Testament, revealed by the Pen of Glory and named “The Book of the Covenant”, Bahá’u’lláh entered into a Covenant with all created things. In all His Tablets and prayers, He hath made firm adherence to the divine Covenant and Testament to be the surest means of receiving heavenly bestowals, that all may apprehend the majesty and grandeur of that Covenant and Testament. Now, some are conscious of the power of this Covenant, and are firm and steadfast in the straight path, whilst others are not yet as aware of its significance as they should be. The sincere friends of the Blessed Beauty must strive to awaken the people. As this mighty, this impregnable stronghold shall remain inviolate and safe, let not thy heart grieve. All other matters are secondary and can be easily resolved with a word or two. Rest thou assured and hopeful, and remain firm and steadfast. The glory of God rest upon thee, and upon the beloved of the Lord. Thou hast asked for permission to write of certain matters. “Let thy sorrowful heart recount all that it desireth”, 113 for my ears are attuned to thee.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: It is the hope of ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá that those youthful souls in the schoolroom of the deeper knowledge will be tended by one who traineth them to love. May they all, throughout the reaches of the spirit, learn well of the hidden mysteries; so well that in the Kingdom of the All-Glorious, each one of them, even as a nightingale endowed with speech, will cry out the secrets of the Heavenly Realm, and like unto a longing lover pour forth his sore need and utter want of the Beloved.
prayers.name: SWAB 107

prayers.text: O God, my God! This Thy handmaid is calling upon Thee, trusting in Thee, turning her face unto Thee, imploring Thee to shed Thy heavenly bounties upon her, and to disclose unto her Thy spiritual mysteries, and to cast upon her the lights of Thy Godhead. O my Lord! Make the eyes of my husband to see. Rejoice Thou his heart with the light of the knowledge of Thee, draw Thou his mind unto Thy luminous beauty, cheer Thou his spirit by revealing unto him Thy manifest splendors. O my Lord! Lift Thou the veil from before his sight. Rain down Thy plenteous bounties upon him, intoxicate him with the wine of love for Thee, make him one of Thy angels whose feet walk upon this earth even as their souls are soaring through the high heavens. Cause him to become a brilliant lamp, shining out with the light of Thy wisdom in the midst of Thy people. Verily, Thou art the Precious, the Ever-Bestowing, the Open of Hand.
prayers.name: BPRY

prayers.text:
O my Lord! Thy servant is thirsty; Grant them to drink from the fount of Thy tenderness and bounty. They are hungry; grant them the table of Thy gifts. They are naked; clothe them with the raiment of Thy knowledge.

O my Lord! They are the pure, the sincere. Guide them to the field of battle. They are the guides. Grant them to speak with reason and proof. They are the servants who attend. Grant them to offer the cup of assurance to all. O my Lord, make them as nightingales singing praise in the garden, as lions lurking in the thickets, as whales swimming in the deep sea.

Indeed, Thou art the Most Compassionate, the Bountiful, the Ever-Giving. There is no God but Thee.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

lo:bpnet.cat: ຜິດ  ຢ່າງໜ້າລະອາຍ.

prayers.text: Praised be Thou, O my Lord, for Thou hast enabled me to recognize the Manifestation of Thine own Self and helped me to fix my heart upon the court of Thy presence, the object of my soul's adoration. I beseech Thee by Thy name which hath caused the heaven to be rent asunder and the earth to cleave, decree for me that which Thou hast decreed for them that have turned away from all else but Thee and have set their hearts towards Thee. Suffer me to sit in Thy presence upon the seat of truth, within the Tabernacle of Glory. Mighty art Thou to do what Thou wilt. There is no other God beside Thee, the All-Glorious, the All-Wise.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is the Most Glorious
O my God, my Lord, my Support, on Thee is my reliance and my trust, and by the cord of Thy grace I hold fast, and at the gate of Thy Oneness I seek to draw nigh. By the breezes of Thy holiness is the life of my heart, and by the attractions of the beauty of Thy oneness, my soul is moved. And by the shining lights from the horizon of Thy uniqueness is the joy of my spirit, and by the winds of Thy providence, my being is stirred. By the manifestations of the Kingdom of Thy mercy is the resurrection of my self. By the confirmations of Thy Most High assembly is my succour, and the exaltation of my word. By the successes of Thy Most Glorious Kingdom is my victory, and the elevation of my purpose. By Thy love is my salvation, and by the knowledge of Thee is my life. And by Thy help is my steadfastness. By the abundance of the clouds of Thy bounty is the quenching of my thirst. By the pure waters of the fount of Thy grace is the cooling of my burning desire. And by the balm of Thy wisdom is the healing of my sickness.
My God, my God, disappoint not my hopes, nor look upon my deeds, and the evil of my state, and the excess of my abasement, and the extremity of my deprivation, and the abundance of my disobedience. Deal with me, O my God, according to what befitteth the loftiness of Thy glory, and deal not with me according to what befitteth my lowliness, and my poverty, and my helplessness.
My God, my God, the eyes are watching for the descent of Thy gifts. My God, my God, the hearts are awaiting the manifestation of the lights of Thy favours. Strengthen Thou my back with Thy victorious power over all created things, and fortify Thou my loins with Thy prevailing might over all that may be brought into existence. And illumine Thou my sight with Thy shining lights from the dawning-place of the Utterances, and expand Thou my breast with Thy dazzling signs from the ascendant-places of Manifestations. And strengthen Thou my soldiers with Thy triumphant banners raised upon the heights of the hearts of the sanctified, speaking Realities, in the earth and in the heavens.
Verily, Thou art the Almighty to do whatsoever Thou pleasest, and verily, Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Wise.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: He is the All-Glorious. O thou who art inebriated by the heavenly cup! In the wilderness of Sinai in the Holy Land, in the hallowed precincts of the vale of Towa, upon the Mystic Mount from which the Light shone upon Moses, the Divine Lote-Tree was raised high, the Burning Bush was unveiled, and the Voice of the one true God was lifted up, raising a tumult in every land and resounding throughout the East and the West. Upon hearing this soul-stirring Voice, every attentive ear responded, “Here am I!” and cried out, from its inmost self, saying, “O our Lord! We have indeed heeded the Voice of Him that called us to the Faith of God—‘Believe ye in your Lord’—and we have believed.” 93 And every soul that was the embodiment of the verse “They are deaf, they are dumb, they are blind and shall return no more” responded, “Lo! This is naught but tales of the Ancients.” 94 Gracious God! Those who claimed to have heard the Voice of God calling from every least bush, rock, and clod of earth—even every blade of grass in the wilderness—rejected that Voice when its most wondrous accents rose from the Tree of Man with utmost eloquence and grace. This is a cause of astonishment, a source of pity. Thus shall the light of “He guideth whomsoever He pleaseth” be kindled and shine forth in the lamp of “He singleth out for His mercy whomsoever He willeth.” 95 This, verily, is the truth. Aid Thou Thy servant, O my Lord, who hath sought the light of Thy oneness from the Lamp of Thy guidance and hearkened to Thy most sweet Voice which hath been raised from Thy most glorious Kingdom. Assist him by the power of Thy triumphant might, and enlighten his heart by Thy Most Great Sign. Gladden his bosom through the sublime outpourings of Thy grace from Thine exalted Kingdom. Thou art, in truth, the Lord of this world and of the next.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: He is God. O ye who yearn for the beauty of the compassionate Beloved! No sooner had He Who is the Beloved of the worlds, the Desire of the spiritually minded, the Object of the adoration of the heavenly souls, and the Promised One of the people of the Bayán been made manifest in Iraq than He stirred and quickened the earth, and shed His radiant light upon human conduct and character. The universe was set in motion, and the whole creation was filled with joy. The reality of each created thing acquired its heavenly significance, and every atom in existence attained unto the Divine Beloved. The East became the Dawning-Place of splendours, and the West was made the horizon of effulgent glory. The earth became heavenly, and darksome dust was made radiant. The glory of the Kingdom was revealed in the world of creation, and this nether realm was awakened to the Realm on high. This world became another world, and the realm of being acquired a new life. With every passing day, these signs will be revealed and made more manifest, these lights will shine more resplendent; and with every passing moment, this musk-laden breeze will shed its perfume upon the world. But alas! The people of Persia remain wrapt in heedless slumber and, like the blind and the deaf, neither see the Light nor hear the Call. They are neither awakened nor mindful. Strive then and exert a mighty effort, for Persia is the homeland of the compassionate Beloved, and Fárs the dawning-place of the resplendent Morn. Perchance, through the high endeavours of the friends, the inhabitants of that land may perceive the rays of that luminous Orb, and may receive their portion of manifold grace from the Lord of tokens and signs. The Glory of Glories rest upon you.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text:
He is the Most Holy, the Most Glorious.

In the name of God, the Compasionate, the Merciful! Praise be to God, the Lord of all worlds!

O Thou my God, my Refuge and my Shelter! How can I fitly call upon Thee, when even the most wondrous words of glorification and the most eloquent praises are inadequate, O Thou Almighty and Forgiving, knowing that the tongue of every eloquent speaker stammereth, and every eulogy from human pen or tongue becometh confused in its endeavour to extol even one of the signs of Thy almighty power or to glorify a single Word which hath been created by Thee. Verily the wings of the birds of human intellect are broken in their attempt to soar to the spheres of Thy divine holiness, and the spiders of vain fancy are unable to weave their fragile web upon the loftiest pinnacles of the canopy of Thy knowledge. Thus there is no recourse for me but to acknowledge my powerlessness and shortcomings, and there is no abode for me save in the depths of poverty and destitution. Verily, powerlessness to comprehend Thee is the essence of comprehension, confession of shortcomings is the only means of reaching Thy presence, and acknowledgment of poverty is the source of true riches.

O Lord! Graciously assist me and Thy devoted servants in our servitude to Thy Exalted Threshold, strengthen us in our supplications to Thy divine holiness, and enable us to be humble and submissive at the door of Thy oneness. Make my steps powerful in Thy path, O my Lord, and enlighten my heart with the rays that shine from the heaven of Thy mysteries. Quicken my spirit with the animating breeze diffused from the paradise of Thy forgiveness and pardon, and gladden my soul through the refreshing breath conveyed from the meads of Thy holiness. Verl
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
Whosoever journeys in the path of learning to various regions, let him recite in the mountain and the desert, on land and on sea, the following prayer:
O God! O God! Thou seest me, frail and lowly and humble amongst Thy creatures; yet I have trusted in Thee and arisen to promote Thy teachings amongst Thy steadfast servants, relying wholly on Thy power and Thy might!
O Lord! I am as a bird with broken wings, yearning to soar into Thy boundless spheres. How can I possibly do so, save through Thy providence and grace, Thy confirmation and aid!
O Lord! Have mercy on my weakness and strengthen me with Thy power! O Lord! Have pity on my infirmity and support me with Thy might and majesty!
O Lord! When the breath of the Holy Spirit hath confirmed the weakest of all creatures, it shall attain the highest station and possess all that it desireth. Thou hast indeed aided Thy servants in days gone by, and they were the weakest of Thy creatures, the lowest of Thy servants, the most unknown of them that dwelt on the face of the earth; but according to Thy will and through Thy power, they preceded the most glorious of Thy people and the most noble of mankind. They were like unknown moths and became royal falcons; they were like soap-bubbles and became seas. Through Thy gifts, Thy mercy, and Thy greatest favour, they became radiant stars on the horizon of guidance, singing birds in the rose-garden of immortality, roaring lions in the forests of knowledge and wisdom, mighty whales in the oceans of life.
Verily, Thou art the Gracious, the Powerful, the Mighty, and the Most Merciful of all merciful ones.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: Thou didst write as to the children: from the very beginning, the children must receive divine education and must continually be reminded to remember their God. Let the love of God pervade their inmost being, commingled with their mother’s milk.
prayers.name: SWAB 99

prayers.text: O thou daughter of the Kingdom! Thy letters were received. Their contents indicated that thy mother hath ascended to the invisible realm and that thou hast been left alone. Thy wish is to serve thy father, who is dear to thee, and also to serve the Kingdom of God, and thou art perplexed as to which of the two thou shouldst do. Assuredly engage in service to thy father, and as well, whenever thou findest time, diffuse the divine fragrances.
prayers.name: SWAB 116

prayers.text:
ou, Lord of kindness! These souls who love Thee are gathered and intoxicated by Thy love. Thy radiant beauty transports them and Thy musk-scented curls fascinate them. They abandon their hearts to Thee and, humble and defenseless, they wander on Thy path. They forsake friends and strangers alike and cleave to Thine uniqueness, bowing in adoration before Thee.

They belonged to this lower world; Thou didst welcome them into Thy kingdom. They were like withered plants in the desert of deprivation and misfortune; Thou hast made them the young shoots of the garden of knowledge and understanding. Their voices had been silenced; Thou hast made them speak. They were discouraged; Thou hast flooded them with light. They were like arid and parched soil; Thou hast transformed them into a rose garden of profound meanings. They were like children in the world of humanity; Thou hast allowed them to reach celestial maturity.

O Thou, the Bountiful! Grant them a haven and a refuge under Thy protection, and keep them from trials and vicissitudes. Grant them Thine unseen aid and give them Thine unfailing grace.

O Thou, benevolent and beloved Lord! They are like the body and Thou art the Spirit of life. The body depends, for its freshness and beauty, on the grace of the spirit. They therefore need Thy confirmations and aspire to receive the powerful support of the Holy Spirit in this new revelation. Thou art the Mighty. Thou art the Giver, the Benefactor, the Generous, and the Clement. Thou art He who shineth forth from the invisible kingdom.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: O thou who art firm in the Covenant, thy letter was received. Thou hast exerted a great effort for that prisoner, perchance it may prove to be fruitful. Tell him, however: “The denizens of the world are confined in the prison of nature—a prison that is continuous and eternal. If thou art at present restrained within the limits of a temporary prison, be not grieved at this; my hope is that thou mayest be emancipated from the prison of nature and may attain unto the court of everlasting life. Pray to God day and night and beg forgiveness and pardon. The omnipotence of God shall solve every difficulty.”
prayers.name: SWAB 82

prayers.text:
O God, raise this new-born in the bosom of Thy love and nourish it with the milk of Thy providence. Nurture this young shoot in the rose-garden of Thy love and water it with the showers of Thy bounty.
Make it a child of the kingdom and guide it to Thy celestial home. Thou art powerful and good. Thou art the Bestower, the Bountiful, the Lord of infinite mercy.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: O thou who hast bowed thyself down in prayer before the Kingdom of God! Blessed art thou, for the beauty of the divine Countenance hath enraptured thy heart, and the light of inner wisdom hath filled it full, and within it shineth the brightness of the Kingdom. Know thou that God is with thee under all conditions, and that He guardeth thee from the changes and chances of this world and hath made thee a handmaid in His mighty vineyard.… As to thy respected husband: it is incumbent upon thee to treat him with great kindness, to consider his wishes and be conciliatory with him at all times, till he seeth that because thou hast directed thyself toward the Kingdom of God, thy tenderness for him and thy love for God have but increased, as well as thy concern for his wishes under all conditions. I beg of the Almighty to keep thee firmly established in His love, and ever shedding abroad the sweet breaths of holiness in all those regions.
prayers.name: SWAB 91

prayers.text:
All friends of God . . . should contribute what they can, however humble that sacrifice may be. God does not lay upon any soul a burden heavier than it can bear. Such contributions must come from all centres and all believers . . . O ye friends of God! Be ye assured that by reason of these contributions, your agriculture, industry and commerce shall receive manifold blessings with favour and bounteous gifts. He that doeth one good deed receiveth a tenfold reward. There is no doubt that the living Lord will abundantly confirm those who give their wealth in His way.
## O God, my God! Illumine the faces of Thy true lovers and make them triumphant with heavenly hosts of certain victory. Make firm their feet on Thy straight path and open to them the gates of Thy gifts with Thy eternal grace; for they spend in Thy ways that which Thou hast given them, guard Thy faith, place their trust in Thy remembrance, sacrifice their hearts for love of Thee, and withhold not aught of that which they possess for adoration of Thy beauty and in their longing to please Thee.
O my Lord! Grant them an abundant share, a destined recompense and a sure reward.
Verily, Thou art the Sustainer, the Helper, the Bountiful, the Ever-Giving.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

lo:bpnet.cat: ເພື່ອການບໍລິຈາກໃຫ້ກອງທຶນສາສະໜາ

prayers.text:
He is the Glory of God
O Merciful, O Compassionate, O Bountiful! East and West are illumined by the lights of the Dawning-Place of Beauty, and the spiritual senses are perfumed by the divine breezes. O God, give Thy servants shelter in the shadow of Thy favour; make the ignorant aware of the mysteries of truth; grant the destitute a refuge and the wanderers a home; gladden the broken-hearted and give wings to the broken-winged birds; let the thirsty drink from the fount of Thy bounty and make the needy independent of the treasure of the kingdom; nourish the children in the cradle of Thy grace until they reach maturity; heal the sick with the heavenly remedy so that they may attain health and well-being.
O God, make the blind to see and the deaf to hear; quicken the dead and revive the withered; make the hopeless hopeful and worthy of all bestowals the deprived; Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Giver, Thou art the Merciful.
O Lord, though we are weak, Thou art powerful; though we are poor, Thou art rich; though we are abased, Thou art exalted. Look not at our poverty and weakness, but rather bestow upon us that which befits Thy absolute riches, power, and might.
Thou art the Merciful, Thou art the Bountiful, Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Compassionate.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
O, my Lord! O, my Lord! Behold, a bird with broken wings whose flight hath been stayed; help it to rise unto the shores of prosperity and salvation, that it may follow Thy path with the utmost joy and happiness, through the boundless spaces, and its song in adoration of Thy Most Great Name may be shed upon all regions of the world, gladdening the ears through its summons and enlightening the eyes that recognise the signs of Thy guidance.

O, my Lord! I am humble and alone. I have no helper but Thee, no refuge save Thee, no comforter save Thee. Confirm me in Thy service, aid me with the hosts of Thine angels, make me victorious in the promulgation of Thy Word, and suffer me to diffuse Thy wisdom amongst Thy creatures. Verily, Thou art the Helper of the poor and the Defender of the humble, and, verily, Thou art the Almighty, the All-Powerful, the Unconstrained.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
* Bahá'u'lláh ordains in the 'Kitáb-i-Aqdas' that this prayer shall be recited, in its entirety, for the deceased at a Bahá'í burial. It is read before the interment of a person while the others stand.


O my God! This is Thy servant and the son of Thy servant who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, and turned his face toward Thee, entirely detached from all except Thee. Verily, of those who show mercy, Thou art the Most Merciful.

Deal with him, O Thou Who art the forgiver of men's sins and the concealer of their faults, as befits the heaven of Thy bounty and the ocean of Thy grace. Suffer him to enter the gates of Thy all-encompassing mercy, which hath existed before the foundation of earth and heaven was laid. There is no God but Thee, the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Bountiful.

Then let him repeat the greeting 'Alláh-u-Abhá' six times, and then repeat each of the following sentences nineteen times:

Verily, we all worship God. Verily, we all bow down to God.

Verily, we are all devoted unto God.

Verily, we all praise God. Verily, we all thank God.

Verily, we are all patient in God.


*(If the deceased is a woman, let him say: "This is Thy handmaid and the daughter of Thy handmaid, etc.")
*(The Universal House of Justice clarifies in a letter dated July 1, 2001, that the repetition of the sentences proceeds as follows: 'Alláh-u-Abhá' [once], 'Verily, we all worship God.' [19 times], 'Alláh-u-Abhá' [once], 'Verily, we all bow down to God.' [19 times], and so on.)
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
O my Lord, my Helper, the Answerer of all my needs! Thy servant is come to repose in the shadow of Thy mercy, to alight beneath the cupola of Thy favour, and to ask for Thy gifts and Thy favours.

I beg of Thee, O my Lord, with Thine eye that slumbereth not, to turn away my gaze from all that is not Thyself. Strengthen Thou my sight, that I may behold Thy signs, and be guided to the lights of Thy countenance. Thou art He whose might hath encompassed all that hath been created.

There is no God but Thou, the Opener, the Victorious, the All-Knowing.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

mi:bpnet.cat: MŌ TE ĀWHINA ME TE MANAAKI

prayers.text: He is God. O thou twig of the Sacred Lote-Tree! The Dispensations of the past manifested either the splendour of the divine Beauty or the radiance of the divine Glory; either the dawning rays of “Verily Thou art of a noble nature” or the bright light of “God, verily, is wholly quit of the unbelievers”; 79 either the effulgence of the manifest Sun or the gleam of the unsheathed sword. But in this great Cycle and blessed Age, despite the lack of an all-subduing power or earthly dominion, despite the absence of unsheathed swords or flashing spears, Glory and Beauty have joined together and shone forth in a single luminous Countenance. Though the Ancient Beauty—may my life be offered up for His loved ones—was held alone and forsaken in the clutches of His enemies, though He was kept in chains and threatened by the sword, though He was banished to lands in Asia and Europe and finally exiled to the Most Great Prison, He ultimately rose in the utmost glory and beauty above the horizon of ancient might, manifest and radiant, resplendent and luminous, shedding light upon the world. All necks were laid low before Him, and all heads bowed down to Him; all faces turned humbly towards Him, and all voices were hushed in His presence.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: The teacher, when teaching, must be himself fully enkindled, so that his utterance, like unto a flame of fire, may exert influence and consume the veil of self and passion. He must also be utterly humble and lowly so that others may be edified, and be totally self-effaced and evanescent so that he may teach with the melody of the Concourse on high—otherwise his teaching will have no effect.
prayers.name: SWAB 217

prayers.text: He is God. O thou who art steadfast in the Covenant! Thou hast asked concerning the travels of Bahá’u’lláh. The Blessed Beauty—may my life be offered up for His loved ones—travelled directly from Ṭihrán to Hamadán, from that city to Kirmán sh áh, and thence straight on to Baghdad. As regardeth the association which hath been formed in Shanghai, China, with the aim of promoting harmony and reconciliation amongst the religions, do thou send to that English lady literature about the Cause and material from the press, and advise her by all means to go to that association and speak about this blessed Cause—a universal religion which bringeth all faiths and creeds together beneath the effulgence of the Sun of Truth, entirely reconciling them and welding them into a single people. This is an important matter to which thou shouldst attend most heedfully. Correspond regularly with them and, if it be possible, send teachers to those parts, who may likewise go to the association and spread the divine teachings. Only such souls should be sent, however, as are detached from the world, attracted by the fragrances of holiness, and distinguished by the utmost purity and sanctity.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text:
He is the All-Baha

Forgiver and Merciful, these pure souls have been freed from the prison of dust and have flown to Thy world. They were good-natured and captivated by Thy Face and thirsty for Thy stream. In the time of their lives, they were revived by the breath of the All-Merciful. They found a seeing eye, they had a hearing ear. They were free from every attachment and were always joyous and delighted by Thy favors. Now they have flown to the world of mystery and in the proximity of Thy mercy, they build nests and abodes upon the Tree of Tuba and engage in song and melody. O Lord, forgive the sins of these souls and raise them from the pit to the zenith of the moon. Guide them into the rose-garden of Thy bounties and grant them refuge in the meadow of Thy forgiveness and pardon. Make them the lords of the free and bring them into the circle of the near ones. Comfort those who remain and grant them ease, and make them the adornment of the created world, that they may engage in Thy praise and in Thy glorification and sanctification. Thou art the All-Forgiving, Thou art the All-Pardoning, Thou art the Forgiver and the Merciful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
The Most Holy, the Most Inaccessible, the Most Great.
The Feast of the Birth has come, and the Beauty of God, the Almighty, the Mighty, the Loving, has established Himself upon the throne. Blessed is he who is present this day before the Face, and to whom the Eye of God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting, has turned. Say: We took the Feast in the Greatest Prison after what the kings rose up against us. Let not the might of any oppressor prevent us, nor shall the hosts of sovereignty disturb us. This is what the Merciful has testified in this Praiseworthy Station. Say: Does the essence of tranquility become disturbed by the clamor of possibility, nay, by His effulgent Beauty upon all that was and all that shall be? This is the might of God, which has encompassed all things, and this is His dominant power over all that is witnessed and all that is beheld. Cling to the cord of might, then remember your Chosen Lord in this dawn wherein all hidden unseen has shone forth. Thus has the Tongue of Eternity spoken on this day wherein the Sealed Nectar has been released. Beware lest the delusions of those who have disbelieved in God disturb you, or suspicions prevent you from this outstretched path.

O People of Splendor! Fly with the pinions of detachment in the atmosphere of the love of your Merciful Lord, then assist Him with what has been revealed in a Preserved Tablet. Beware lest you dispute with any of the servants; rather, manifest through the fragrance of God and His exposition, by which all faces are directed. Verily, those who are heedless this day are in a drunkenness of desire, and they comprehend not. Blessed is he who turns to the dawning-place of his Lord's signs with submission and repentance. Verily, thou art He who arises among the servants, then reminds them of what has been revealed in the Book of their Noble, Chosen Lord. Say: Fear God, and follow not the delusions of those who have pursued every sinful doubter. Turn with luminous hearts to the direction of your Lord's Throne, the Possessor of Names. He shall indeed support you with Truth. There is no god but He, the Mighty, the Bountiful. Do you hasten to the pool, and the Greatest Ocean?
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
O Lord my God! We are weak, but Thou art the Lord of Power. We are pitiable, but Thou art the Most Mighty, the Most Glorious. We are poor, but Thou art the Lord of all Wealth, the Most Generous. Aid us with Thy boundless grace to serve at Thy Holy Threshold, and with the power of Thy favour and grace support and uphold us as we worship Thee in the places where Thy praise shall flow forth. Help us to spread Thy holy fragrance among Thy creatures, and strengthen our bodies to serve Thee among Thy devoted servants. That we may guide all nations towards Thy Most Great Glory, and call all peoples to the shores of the wondrous ocean of Thy unity.

O Lord of Heaven! Deliver us from the fetters of the earth and its peoples, from the sins and iniquities of past ages, and from the tribulations of the future, so that we may with exceeding joy and radiant gladness proclaim and spread abroad only Thy Word, and rejoice in praising Thee day and night, call all peoples to the path of guidance, charge them to adhere to uprightness and justice, and become the singers of Thy praises among all Thy creatures. Thou art able to do whatsoever Thou pleasest. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the All-Powerful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is God.
O Thou the Goal of all desire, we thank Thee that our eyes have been illumined by beholding Thee, and our hearts and souls have become envious of the rose-garden and meadow through the breezes of Thy holiness. The breezes of fellowship have been felt, and the breaths of the Holy Spirit have been diffused, the soul hath reached the Beloved, and the heart hath found its way to the presence-chamber, and hath become aware of the hidden secret and the guarded sign.
O Lord, give us shelter in the ark of Thy protection, and grant us a refuge and sanctuary in the stronghold of Thy favour.
O Kind One, if Thou dost favour, it is the essence of faithfulness and the reality of bounty; and if Thou dost chastise, it is deserving of punishment and injustice. Bestow freely whatsoever is worthy of Thy Threshold, and make abundant whatsoever is meet for the realities. Graciously make the lowly, through Thy pure gift, the honored ones of the Kingdom, and the abject, through Thine utmost mercy, the manifestors of the bounty of the Godhead.
O Lord, preserve, keep safe, that the foot may not slip, and fall into the lowest depths. Thou art the Almighty, the Glorious, the Capable; Thou art the Knower, the Seer, the Wise. Verily Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: He is God. O thou seeker after truth! Behold the power and greatness of Bahá’u’lláh! Within a short span of time, He hath stirred up the East and the West, and raised aloft, in the midmost heart of the world, the banner of love and harmony, of unity and peace, of fellowship and conciliation, of truthfulness and rectitude. He hath freed from enmity and strife a great multitude of souls belonging to divers and opposing nations, to disparate and contending religions, and hath brought them under the sheltering canopy of fellowship, love, and unity. What power this is, and what strength! What greater proof couldst thou desire? He hath brought East and West into close embrace. Singly and alone, He hath withstood the world and uplifted His mighty Cause in the Most Great Prison. Though subjected to utter abasement, He hath crowned His loved ones with the diadem of everlasting glory. Were one to gaze with the eye of justice, this would be sufficient proof. Thou hast written concerning the cost of postage. ‘Abdu’l-Bahá hath offered up his life for thee, how much more his earthly possessions! Upon thee be greetings and praise.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text:
He is God!
O Lord! This assemblage hath gathered in this meeting out of pure love and with utmost unity and accord. O God! Illumine the faces, gladden the spirits with the Great Glad-Tidings, brighten the eyes with the beholding of the signs of guidance, and make the ears to delight in hearkening to the Call from on high. O Lord! We are all sinners; do Thou forgive us. We are all full of faults; do Thou pardon us. Grant us Thy shelter, and through Thy forgiveness, make our shortcomings perfect. Deliver these souls from the world of illusions and guide them to the Truth, that they may search after reality, be distanced from the world of dust, and draw nigh unto the Kingdom. May they be freed from this darksome world and be joined to the world of light. Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty, the Giver, the Kind.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

fa:bpapp.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

fa:bpnet.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

prayers.text: He is God. O thou binder of books! Shouldst thou refer to the heavenly Books and Sacred Scriptures, and ponder the meanings enshrined therein, thou wouldst see that all their tidings and signs herald the advent of the Light of Truth and the Centre of Divinity. Forget not the tradition that saith: “Whatsoever is in the Torah, the Gospel, and other Scriptures is in the Qur’án, and whatsoever is in the Qur’án is in its Exordium, and whatsoever is in its Exordium is in the Basmalah, and whatsoever is in the Basmalah is in the Bá’.” 121 But alas, for the eyes of the people are blind, and their ears are deaf. How well hath it been said: To speak of the subtleties of Saná’í before the foolish and the weak of mind Is like plucking the lute for the deaf or holding a mirror to the blind. Gracious God! How strange, how very strange! The people of the Book have withdrawn behind the veils, whilst the common people comprehend the mysteries of the Word. This is but a token of the bounteous favour of my Lord, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful. Upon thee be greetings and praise.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: He is God. O ‘Abdu’l-Vahháb! During His first journey to Iraq, the Blessed Beauty met a young man by the name of Mírzá ‘Abdu’l-Vahháb. No sooner had this youth attained His presence and hearkened unto His words than, lo, he became so magnetized, so suffused with joy, that he guided his family to the truth and imparted the gladsome tidings to a great many. Following the return of Him Who is the Most Great Name to Ṭihrán, Mírzá ‘Abdu’l-Vahháb hastened to that sacred land, dancing with delight and leaping with joy, only to be consigned, upon arrival, to the depths of the dungeon. A few days later, his turn came to be martyred. When the executioner stepped into the dungeon and shouted out his name, that young man, still in the prime of his years, leapt to his feet, danced for joy in that prison, and surrendered himself to the executioner. Thus did he attain supreme martyrdom. The Blessed Beauty frequently spoke of him. I fervently hope that the joy and radiance of that ‘Abdu’l-Vahháb may also be manifested in this one. The Glory of Glories rest upon thee.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: He is the All-Glorious. O thou who art aflame with the fire of the love of God! We hear that thou hast within thy being a blazing fire, and that thy soul, even as the winged moth, is consumed by its flame. Within the lamp of thy heart is cradled a bright candle, and within the sanctuary of thy soul reigneth the Best-Beloved of every gathering. Gracious God! What a concealed mystery is this and what a wondrous reality: The once-cloistered Friend hath become renowned throughout the world, and the once-hidden Beloved hath been unveiled in every land! That everlasting Beauty hath now ascended to the eternal Kingdom. That Day-Star of the realm of Divine Unity is now shrouded behind the clouds of the invisible world. Despite this, the spreading rays of His holiness shine resplendent from the wellspring of the hearts of those who embody His praise. And while the mighty Ocean is concealed in the dense clouds of the world, yet its majestic billows surge from the wellsprings of the realm of being and are visible upon the shores of existence. Thus, while hidden, He is manifest, and though wrapt in concealment, He standeth revealed above every horizon in the easts and the wests of the earth.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: He is God. O thou my fellow countryman! Although ‘Abdu’l-Bahá was born in Ṭihrán and for successive years wandered homeless in Iraq, and although he was for a time an exile in Rumelia and for forty years a prisoner in ‘Akká, yet his homeland is Mázindarán—that is to say, the district of Míyánrúd in the region of Núr. Therefore, I address thee as my countryman. Thy splendid letter aroused spiritual affections in my heart. I read it with admiration, for it was a melody of Divine Unity and an ensign proclaiming His oneness. I, too, am most eager to meet thee. If the means become available for thee to travel in peace and tranquillity, thou mayest come next winter. Praised be God! Whenever I read the name of someone from Mázindarán at the end of any letter, it bringeth me gladness and delight, inasmuch as it is the ancestral home of the family of the Blessed Beauty. My heart longeth for that land to become even as Paradise itself, and for its people to recognize and embrace the Great Announcement. The Glory of Glories rest upon thee.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: O my Lord, my Defender, my Help in peril! Lowly do I entreat Thee, ailing do I come unto Thee to be healed, humbly do I cry out to Thee with my tongue, my soul, my spirit: O God, my God! The gloom of night hath shrouded every region, and all the earth is shut away behind thick clouds. The peoples of the world are sunk in the black depths of vain illusions, while their tyrants wallow in cruelty and hate. I see nothing but the glare of searing fires that blaze upward from the nethermost abyss, I hear nothing save the thunderous roar that belloweth out from thousands upon thousands of fiery weapons of assault, while every land is crying aloud in its secret tongue: ‘My riches avail me nothing, and my sovereignty hath perished!’ O my Lord, the lamps of guidance have gone out. The flames of passion are mounting high, and malevolence is ever gaining on the world. Malice and hate have overspread the face of the whole earth, and I find no souls except Thine own oppressed small band who are raising up this cry: Make haste to love! Make haste to trust! Make haste to give! To guidance come! Come ye for harmony! To behold the Star of Day! Come here for kindliness, for ease! Come here for amity and peace! Come and cast down your weapons of wrath, till unity is won! Come and in the Lord’s true path each one help each one. Verily with exceeding joy, with heart and soul, do these oppressed of Thine offer themselves up for all mankind in every land. Thou seest them, O my Lord, weeping over the tears Thy people shed, mourning the grief of Thy children, condoling with humankind, suffering because of the calamities that beset all the denizens of the earth. O my Lord, wing them with victory that they may soar upward to salvation, strengthen their loins in service to Thy people, and their backs in servitude to Thy Threshold of Holiness. Verily Thou art the Generous, verily Thou art the Merciful! There is none other God save Thee, the Clement, the Pitiful, the Ancient of Days! ‘Abdu’l-Bahá Selections from the Writings of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá, 218.10–218.18

alt_sources.text:
O my Lord, my Defender, my Help in peril! With utmost lowliness I beg of Thee; sick, I turn to Thee, hoping for Thy healing; to Thee I cry, humbly, with speech, soul and spirit:
O God, my God! The darkness of the night hath enveloped all regions, and the entire earth is veiled in dense clouds. The peoples of the world are submerged in the dark depths of vain illusions, while their tyrants swim in cruelty and hatred. I see naught but the gleam of devouring, burning fires that rise from the bottom of the abyss; no sound reaches my ears save the deafening roar produced by the rumbling of thousands upon thousands of attacking firearms, whilst every plague exclaims, in a loud voice, in its secret tongue: "My riches are of no avail to me, and my sovereignty hath perished!"
O my Lord! The lamps of guidance have been extinguished. The flames of passion surge to the heights, and malevolence is continually gaining ground in the world. Malice and rancor have spread over the face of the earth, and I find no soul save Thy own companions, oppressed and scarce, who raise this cry:
Hasten ye at once to love! Hasten ye at once to fidelity! Hasten ye to bestow gifts! Come ye to be guided!
Come ye to harmony! Come ye to behold the sun! Come ye hither to kindness, to well-being! Come ye hither to friendship and peace!
Come ye and cast down your weapons of wrath, until unity be achieved! Come ye, and on the true path of the Lord, let us help one another!
These Thy downtrodden ones, verily, with extreme joy, in body and soul, sacrifice their lives for the whole of humanity, in all regions. Thou seest them, O my Lord, weeping the tears shed for Thy people, afflicted by the pain of Thy children, pitying humankind, suffering by virtue of the calamities that beset all the inhabitants of the earth.
O my Lord! Endow them with the wings of victory, that they may soar to the heavens of salvation; strengthen them in the

prayers.text:
He is God

O Lord, O merciful Creator, Thy servants are scattered and dispersed and distressed in the regions and quarters, wandering without aim or provision, in every breath ensnared in a trap, and in every day wandering in a land, they find solace in Thy remembrance and are aflame in the fire of Thy love, they are bewildered in Thy street and dishevelled in face and form. Bestow Thy favour, grant Thy grace, that all may be gathered together in the extended shade and the glorious tent, under the banner of the desired goal, and seated upon couches, facing each other, and drink from the cup of Thy bestowal and be intoxicated with the wine of Thy favour, Thou art the Able, the Powerful.

O Lord, protect these shining lamps from the winds of trial and tribulation, and grant a resting-place in the garden of Thy grace to these birds with broken wings, grant a portion to these dispossessed, and bestow a cure upon these helpless ones. Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Merciful, and Thou art the All-Knowing.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is God! O Thou Almighty Lord! Strengthen all mankind that they may do according to the instructions and teachings recorded in these writings, so that wars and strifes may be eliminated from the world of man; that the roots of enmity may be destroyed and the foundations of love and affection be established; that the hearts may be filled with love and the souls be attracted; that wisdom may advance and the faces become brightened and illumined; that there be no more wars and strifes and that reconciliation and peace appear; that the Unity of the world of man may pitch its tent on the “apex of the horizons,” so that peoples and parties become as one nation, that different continents become as one continent and the whole earth as one land; that the sects of antagonizing and dogmatic religions be unified; that the world of creation be adorned and all the people of the earth abide in unity and peace.

Verily, Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the Beholder!
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: He is God. O thou who art steadfast in the Covenant! The letter thou hadst written to Ma sh hadí Ismá‘íl hath been received. The traces of the pen of that loving friend have brought joy to my heart and mind, for their inner meanings are spiritual impressions and heartfelt sentiments derived from the reality of the soul; they are sufficient testimony to firmness and constancy, and to servitude to the all-sufficing Lord. From the earliest dawn of the Morn of divine guidance, Á dh irbáyján raised aloft the banner of faith and certitude, and the Cause of God thereby spread far and wide. But following the martyrdom of the Exalted One, the journey of the Blessed Beauty from Iraq to Kurdistan, and the seclusion of Yaḥyá in a corner of oblivion, the Cause of God sank deep into apathy everywhere, even in Á dh irbáyján. Only a few souls remained steadfast and calm until the Day-Star of the world returned to Iraq and the splendours of His light shone upon all regions in the plenitude of their glory. Once again, a Great Resurrection was witnessed and the sweet savours of holiness were shed upon the whole world. The friends in Á dh irbáyján were stirred up in blissful rapture, and their enthusiasm, joy, and fervour waxed greater day by day. Now, too, receptivity in that land is great, but a mighty effort is needed if the friends are to impart these joyful tidings with gladness and delight, and to perfume the senses of the seekers with the fragrance of the robe of the divine Joseph. Praise be to God that thou hast arisen to serve Him and art earnestly striving to exalt the Word of God. My hope is that, through the sincerity of souls, the hearts and minds of the people of Á dh irbáyján may be stirred in these days, and sanctified beings may arise to guide the people aright. The forces of the Kingdom stand ready and expectant. As soon as a soul urgeth the steed of high endeavour into the field of sacrifice, these heavenly forces will rush forth to his aid and will render him assistance and support. Thou hadst requested permission for a visit. At this time, thy presence in those regions is much needed. Thou art occupied with service, manifesting complete servitude and devoted to the promotion of the Word of God. Such service is the same as attaining to the Sacred Threshold of the Lord. The Glory of Glories rest upon thee.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: O thou seeker of truth! Thy letter was received. Thou hast asked me for a written history as well as a record of the prophecies concerning the Báb and Bahá’u’lláh. These have both been previously written. Search for them and thou wilt find them. Regarding the Blessed Beauty, He was not born of the line of Ishmael but was, rather, a descendant of one of the other brothers who had migrated to Persia and the Afghan territories. For, apart from Isaac and Ishmael, Abraham had six sons who all moved to Persia and to the Afghan regions. O thou sincere seeker! Strive thou with all thy might to summon the people to the heavenly Kingdom, so that through divine guidance thou mayest enable the human souls to become even as the angels of Paradise, mayest promote universal peace in this distinguished Age and serve the oneness of the world of humanity, and mayest attain unto everlasting life, follow the example of Christ, and become a companion of ‘Abdu’l-Bahá in this path. Upon thee be greetings and praise.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text:
O Kind, Forgiving, and Radiant Lord of earth and heaven,
we are all gathered, yearning for You,
needy, Your dervishes,
helpless wanderers and distraught fallen ones,
dejected, withered ones,
in pain, grant healing,
ailing, bestow a remedy,
disheartened, give us a flame,
withered, scatter a glimmer,
strangers, make us known (to You),
make us moths burnt by the candle of faithfulness,
thirsty and steeped in heart's blood, bring forth a delightful spring and let us drink from the water of life,
cast commotion in the city and spread a tumult in the universe, so that hearts may become astonished by You and souls may be sacrificed to You.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

fa:bpapp.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

fa:bpnet.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

prayers.text:
He is the Glory.
O Thou forgiving God, O Thou the Bountiful! These souls, like birds of swift wing, have been freed from the snares of the earthly world and have taken their flight unto the heavenly kingdom; they have escaped from the nest of dust and have flown to the abode of the pure world. They cherish the hope that in the luminous rose-garden of the world above they may find their dwelling-place upon the cypress of the paradise garden and abide in the palace of forgiveness.

O Thou kind Lord! Guide every pure soul to the Divine threshold, and honour every helpless suppliant within Thy blessed paradise; cast them into the ocean of Thy bounty and generosity, and suffer them to behold Thy radiant countenance. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the Forgiver, and the Merciful. Alláh-u-Abhá
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is God

O God, O Forgiver of error, O Remover of transgressions and iniquities, Thou forgivest whom Thou willest by Thy vast mercy and Thy radiant compassions. Verily, I supplicate unto Thee with all shame and bashfulness for the errors that have issued from me. Nevertheless, I beg of Thee to pardon these, and to forgive their sins, and to shelter them within the precincts of Thy great mercy.

O Lord, they have none but Thee; none can succor them but Thee; none can save them but Thee.

O Lord, have mercy upon them by Thy grace and Thy favors; draw them out from the abyss of deprivation, and deliver them from the pit of estrangement; and cause them to enter the Paradise of contentment, and bestow upon them the chalice of forgiveness and bounty.

Verily, Thou art the Gentle, the Merciful, the Compassionate. and Thou art the Forgiving, the Loving, the Helper.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is the Glory of the Most Glorious
O kind Lord, make these Thy servants detached from stranger and kin, and make them intimate with the breezes of the garden of Thy Abhá Kingdom; illuminate the eyes with the vision of Thy lights, and make the souls a garden and meadow; make the hearts a garden of faithfulness, and the breasts a source of divine blessings from the Supreme Concourse. Bestow abundantly the grace of the Holy Spirit, and grant freely the power of the Faithful Spirit, so that Thy friends may arise in Thy service with heavenly strength, with divine power, with majestic might, with heavenly confirmation, with celestial hosts, with a divine breath, with a lordly gift, with the luminous hand of Moses, with the breath of Christ, with the intimacy of Abraham, with the love of the Beloved, with the beauty of Joseph, with the longing of Jacob, and the patience of Job.
O Lord, grant them success in this endeavor; verily, Thou art the Powerful, the All-Glorious.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: He is the All-Glorious. O thou who hast truly believed in the Ancient Beauty! The King of eternal glory, the sovereign Lord, hath been established upon the throne of grandeur and hath shed abroad the splendour of all His names and attributes. He, verily, hath seated Himself upon the Seat of Divinity and sent forth His universal summons. By “Seat” here is meant the Cause of God and His religion, this glorious Dispensation and wondrous Age. And by “seated” is meant His manifestation and appearance, His effulgence and presence. The brows of some were adorned with the brightness of this effulgent light, whilst others regarded this daybreak as powerful sorcery. 76 Gracious God! The dawn is the same, the rising of the Sun is the same, and the Source of all splendour is the same. Yet its effect is of two kinds: “And we send down of the Qur’án that which is a healing and a mercy to the faithful: But it shall only add to the ruin of the wicked.” 77 The glory of God rest upon thee.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text:
He is the All-Glorious!

O pure God, O loving Lord! These companions are captivated by Thy fragrance and bewildered in Thy path. They have freed themselves from every bond and joined themselves to Thy love. They are detached from the world and its people, and are enthralled and ensnared by Thy love. They seek no cure for any pain but Thy grace, and no balm for any wound but in Thy path. They ever desire Thy endless forgiveness and crave Thy boundless favors.

O Kind Bestower! Ennoble these Thy lowly ones and make these captives of Thy love to be princes. Raise them to the highest heaven, and in their self-sacrifice, establish them upon the throne of eternal glory.

Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Seeing, the All-Hearing.

Praise be to Thee for that which Thou hast guided us to, and thanks be to Thee for that which Thou hast fulfilled. We praise Thee and thank Thee for Thy bounty, and we supplicate Thee every morning and evening.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

fa:bpapp.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

fa:bpnet.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

prayers.text: ‘Abdu’l‑Bahá hath long cherished the desire that a Ma sh riqu’l-A dh kár be upraised in that region. Praised be God, thanks to the strenuous efforts of the friends, in recent days the joyful news of this hath been announced. This service is highly acceptable at the Threshold of God, for the Ma sh riqu’l-A dh kár inspiriteth the lovers of God and delighteth their hearts, and causeth them to become steadfast and firm. This is a matter of the utmost significance. If the erection of the House of Worship in a public place would arouse the hostility of evildoers, then the meeting must, in every locality, be held in some hidden place. Even in every hamlet, a place must be set aside as the Ma sh riqu’l-A dh kár, and even though it be underground. Now, praised be God, ye have succeeded in this. Engage ye in the remembrance of God at dawn; rise ye up to praise and glorify Him. Blessed are ye, and joy be yours, O ye the righteous, for having established the Dawning-Point of the Praises of God. Verily I ask of the Lord that He make you standards of salvation and banners of redemption, rippling high over the valleys and hills.
prayers.name: SWAB 59

prayers.text:
He is the Glory of God

O Lord, O Thou All-Knowing, O Thou Merciful, this servant of Thine has hastened from the utmost regions of the East to the West, so that perhaps the nostrils of these souls may be perfumed by the breaths of Thy favours, the breeze of the garden of guidance may blow over these lands, souls may find themselves receptive to Thy bestowals, hearts may be gladdened by Thy glad tidings, eyes may behold the light of truth, ears may receive their share and portion from the call of the Kingdom.

O Lord, enlighten the hearts, O merciful Lord, make the hearts the envy of the rose garden and the orchard, O unique Beloved, waft the breezes of Thy favour, let the lights of Thy bounty shine, so that hearts may become pure and cleansed, receive their share and portion of Thy confirmations, this gathering may tread Thy path, seek Thy secret, behold Thy face, and adopt Thy character.

O Lord, bestow Thine unending bounties, make the treasure of guidance freely available, so that these helpless ones may find a remedy.

Thou art the Merciful, Thou art the Bountiful, Thou art the Knowing and the All-Powerful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)
(LLM translated)

th:bpnet.cat: บทอธิษฐานขอความช่วยเหลือ

prayers.text: Behold, O my Lord, my dwelling in the heart of this mountain, and Thou art a witness to my patience. Verily, I have longed for naught but Thy love and the love of them that love Thee. How can I extol the resplendent beauty of Thy Lordship, conscious as I am of my utter nothingness before the effulgence of Thy glory? Yet the anguish of separation and isolation impels me to call upon Thee with this supplication: that perchance Thy faithful servants may become aware of my lamentations, and supplicate Thee for me, and Thou mayest deign to answer their prayers, as a token of grace and favour. I bear witness that there is none other God beside Thee, for Thou art enshrouded in the mantle of sovereignty, greatness, glory, and power, which no one among Thy servants can imagine or comprehend. Behold, by virtue of that which is inherent in Thy Essence, Thou shalt remain eternally inaccessible to all save Thyself.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
All the friends of God... should contribute to the extent possible, however modest their offering may be. God doth not burden a soul beyond its capacity. Such contributions must come from all centers and all believers. . . . O Friends of God! Be ye assured that in place of these contributions, your agriculture, your industry, and your commerce will be blessed by manifold increases, with goodly gifts and bestowals. He who cometh with one goodly deed will receive a tenfold reward. There is no doubt that the living Lord will abundantly confirm those who expend their wealth in His path.

O God, my God! Illumine the brows of Thy true lovers, and support them with angelic hosts of certain triumph. Set firm their feet on Thy straight path, and out of Thine ancient bounty open before them the portals of Thy blessings; for they are expending on Thy pathway what Thou hast bestowed upon them, safeguarding Thy Faith, putting their trust in their remembrance of Thee, offering up their hearts for love of Thee, and withholding not what they possess in adoration for Thy Beauty and in their search for ways to please Thee.

O my Lord! Ordain for them a plenteous share, a destined recompense and sure reward. Verily, Thou art the Sustainer, the Helper, the Generous, the Bountiful, the Ever-Bestowing.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
O God! Draw us to Thy love, inflame us with Thy tenderness; satisfy us from the ocean of Thy bounty; assuage our hunger with the riches of Thy eternal grace; and clothe us with Thy glory. The birds of the air and the beasts of the field receive their sustenance each day from Thee, and all living things are nourished by Thy grace and tenderness.

Let not this frail creature be deprived of Thy favour, and strengthen through Thy power this helpless soul with Thy gift.

Give us our daily bread, and multiply Thy gifts for the sustenance of life, that we may not be dependent on aught else save Thee, may commune fully with Thee, may walk in all Thy ways, and declare all Thy mysteries.

Thou art the Almighty and Loving, and the Provider for all mankind.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: He is the All-Glorious. O thou servant of the Ancient Beauty! When Joseph—peace be upon him—unveiled his bright countenance in the Egypt of beauty, he set ablaze the souls of a myriad buyers. Now the Joseph of the celestial Canaan, the ruler of the Egypt of the spirit, with a face radiant as the sun and a beauty far above the praise and description of such as are endued with understanding, hath rent asunder the veils and emerged resplendent in the midmost heart of the world. But alas, all the buyers have busied themselves with the world of water and clay, have pursued their selfish desires, and have hence been deprived of beholding His Countenance and attaining His presence. Render thou thanks unto God that thou hast been among the buyers who seek that Divine Beauty, and among those who are enamoured by the Mystic Beloved. The glory of God rest upon thee and upon all those who have been enraptured by His Beauty.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text: He is God! O servant of the one true God! The Morn of divine guidance hath shed its radiance upon the East and lit up the Orient. It hath cast its beams upon the West and brightened the Occident. God be praised, for the renown and glory of the Abhá Beauty hath conquered the world, and the fame of the advent of the Most Great Name hath stirred up the whole earth. His call is now raised in every land, and His life-giving breezes blow from every region. Yet, regrettably, the unfaithful are striving to the utmost to extinguish His radiant Light, to still the wafting of His perfumed breeze, and to hinder the diffusion of His sweet fragrance. Alas, alas! Even if the dark clouds obscure the light of the sun for a while, they shall, in the end, be dispersed, and its effulgent rays shall shine forth once again. Upon thee be greetings and praise.
prayers.name: LOTW

prayers.text:
O Thou the Glory of the Most Glorious.

    O Lord, O Merciful! These friends are attached to the threshold of Thy presence, and these companions are flames burning in the fire of Thy love, like a surging sea in Thy remembrance, and like a lamp shining in the assembly of Unity.

    Each one is a wave of Thy sea of mercy, each one a small casket of the pearl of guidance.

    Every morning they weep earnestly with an open heart, and every night they fall asleep in remembrance of Thy Countenance.

    Thou art Forgiving, Merciful, and Thou art Eternal and Most Compassionate.

    Show mercy to those who have departed, grant patience to those who remain.

    Forgive transgressions and pardon sins.

    Thou art the Concealer, Thou art the Bestower; and upon you be the Glory.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is God

O Lord, this pure soul turned its attention unto Thy kingdom and made supplication and plea. While it was a captive of the material world, it intended to enter the kingdom of permanence and turned its attention toward the spiritual world, hoping for Thine infinite favours.

O Forgiver, forgive the sin and bestow pardon and forgiveness. Lead this thirsty one to the spring of life and plunge this fish into the boundless ocean of Thy forgiveness, that this bird may wing its way to the divine rose-garden and enter the infinite gardens of Thy pardon and forgiveness.

Thou art indeed the Forgiving, the Generous, the Merciful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
O Merciful Lord, illuminate the hearts with the light of the Most Great Guidance, quicken the souls with the Most Great Glad-Tidings, brighten the eyes with the vision of Thy lights, make the ears attentive to the hearing of Thy call, cause us to enter Thy hallowed kingdom and to be revived by the breaths of the Holy Spirit, grant eternal life, bestow heavenly perfections.
O Lord, sacrifice our souls unto Thee, and bestow upon us a new spirit, grant heavenly strength, bestow eternal joy, make us successful in the service of the world of humanity, and be the cause of unity amongst hearts.
O Lord, awaken us from slumber and make us wise and vigilant, that we may comprehend the mysteries of Thy holy book and grasp the secrets of Thy words.
Thou art Powerful, Thou art the Giver, Thou art the Merciful.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text: Those souls that, in this day, enter the divine kingdom and attain everlasting life, although materially dwelling on earth, yet in reality soar in the realm of heaven. Their bodies may linger on earth but their spirits travel in the immensity of space. For as thoughts widen and become illumined, they acquire the power of flight and transport man to the kingdom of God.
prayers.name: SWAB 173

prayers.text: O Thou forgiving God! Forgive the sins of my loving mother, pardon her shortcomings, cast upon her the glance of Thy gracious providence, and enable her to gain admittance into Thy Kingdom. O God! From the earliest days of my life she educated and nurtured me, yet I did not recompense her for her toil and labours. Do Thou reward her by granting her eternal life and making her exalted in Thy Kingdom. Verily, Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, and the Kind. ‘Abdu’l-Bahá

He is God
O Lord, make this sinner weary of all save Thee, and enamoured of Thy love; release him from the chains and snares of desire and passion, and cast him into the snare of the love of the Beauty of El-Abhá, so that I may forget all that is other than Him, and become intoxicated and enraptured by the wine of Thy love. O Lord, I am ignorant and entangled in my own imaginings; provide a remedy and save this fallen one from the lower self, which whispers temptations every moment and sets a new snare with every breath. O Lord, Thou art the Savior and the Liberator; provide a remedy with Thy holy breaths, that perchance this heart may be freed from the world of water and clay, and soar in the heights of Divine Mercy, and find rest in the spirit of detachment.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

prayers.text:
He is God
O Lord, bestow upon Thy yearning servants the effulgence of Thy favour and open wide the doors of Thy bestowal. Purify them from every impurity and cleanse them, and deliver them from all unworthiness. Perfume their garments like the tunic of Joseph, and fill their character and their dispositions with musk and ambergris like the pouch of the morning breeze. Clothe them with the attributes of Thy loving-kindness and adorn them with the manners of the spiritual assembly, so that they may become manifestations of the signs of Thy oneness and evidences of the effulgent light of the unique Lord, and causes of the glory of Thy Cause and the exaltation of their own station, that their extremity may be changed into ease, and their poverty into riches; that they may gain eternal glory and everlasting favour, become manifestations of holiness and the dawning-places of sanctity, and recount the accounts of the world of lights and spirituality, so that all doors may be opened unto them from all directions. Verily, Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)

fa:bpnet.cat: محافل روحانی مجامع و جلسات عمومی

prayers.text:
Thou art the Almighty, the Forgiver, the Merciful! O my Lord, my Lord! Thou seest Thy servants in the depths of hell and error. O Desire of the world, where is the Light of Thy guidance? Thou knowest that they are weak and unable to help themselves. O Thou whose dominion over heaven and earth is in Thy hand, where is Thy dominion?

O my Master, my Lord! I beseech the light of the lamp of Thy grace, the waves of the ocean of Thy knowledge, the utterance with which Thou rulest the people in Thy kingdom. Grant that I may be among those who follow the command in Thy Book, decree for me that which Thou hast decreed for them whom Thou trustest, who have drunk the immortal water of inspiration from the cup of Thy favour. Hasten to do what pleaseth Thee, cling to Thy will and Thy decree. Thou art powerful to do what Thou wishest. There is no God but Thee, the All-knowing, the All-wise.

O my Master, let Thy favour manifest unto me that which will make me radiant in this world and the world to come, and bring me unto Thee. O Lord of mankind, there is no God but Thee, the One, the Almighty, the Praised One.
prayers.name: (LLM translated)
